Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JPM.
We generated $7.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $19.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.60 per share.
Revenue guidance of $19.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 91 basis points to 60.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 91 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
